description:
You are a DevOps Engineer serving as Release Manager at a mid-size e-commerce company. Platform v3.0 is scheduled for deployment during the maintenance window 2026-03-07 02:00-06:00 UTC. Four engineering teams (Frontend, Backend, Payments, Infrastructure) have posted their pre-release checklists in their respective channels. You need to coordinate the release across all teams.

Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Perform the following actions:

1. Review the pre-release checklists in all four team channels (#team-frontend, #team-backend, #team-payments, #team-infra) to understand each team's readiness status
2. Create a public channel named exactly: release-v3-coordination
3. Set its topic to: Platform v3.0 Release | Deployment window: 2026-03-07 02:00-06:00 UTC | Status: Coordinating
4. Invite: vp.engineering, frontend.lead, backend.lead, payments.lead, infra.lead, qa.lead
5. Post a deployment runbook message in the coordination channel with the ordered deployment sequence: (1) Infrastructure changes first, (2) Backend services, (3) Payments service, (4) Frontend assets. Include rollback triggers (error rate >2%, latency >500ms, payment failure rate >0.1%)
6. Pin the deployment runbook message
7. Post a go/no-go status tracker message in the coordination channel summarizing each team's readiness: Backend=GO, Payments=GO, Infrastructure=GO, Frontend=CONDITIONAL (pending cross-browser tests)
8. Post a message in #team-frontend asking for an update on the cross-browser regression suite status and confirming the deployment window
9. Post a rollback procedure summary message in the coordination channel listing each team's specific rollback procedure as found in their checklists
10. Send a direct message to vp.engineering with the release readiness summary: 3 teams GO, 1 team CONDITIONAL, deployment window confirmed, and key risks
11. Post a release notice in #release-announcements announcing the v3.0 deployment window and asking all teams to be on standby
